newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.39125/3.3930 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.39125/3.3930 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3905 to 3.3920 pounds bid, and 3.3925 and 3.3930 pounds offered, in the interbank market on Monday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.39125 pounds bid and 3.39300 pounds offered. The averages compared with 3.3906 pounds bid and 3.3940 pounds offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390816 buy and 3.398180 sell.
